+===== Encoding
+
+REV is encoded in the OP-IMM major opcode as a unary instruction. The encoding
+differs between RV32 and RV64.
+
+RV32:
+
+[wavedrom, ,svg]
+....
+{reg:[
+    { bits: 7, name: 0x13 },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rd' },
+    { bits: 3, name: 0x5 },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs1' },
+    { bits: 12, name: 0x69f },
+]}
+....
+
+RV64:
+
+[wavedrom, ,svg]
+....
+{reg:[
+    { bits: 7, name: 0x13 },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rd' },
+    { bits: 3, name: 0x5 },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs1' },
+    { bits: 12, name: 0x6bf },
+]}
+....
+
+===== Operation
+
+[source,pseudocode]
+----
+a = X[rs1]
+
+// Reverse all bits in the XLEN-wide value
+for i = 0 .. (XLEN - 1):
+    d[i] = a[XLEN - 1 - i]
+
+X[rd] = d
+----
+
+===== Description
+
+REV reverses the bit order of the full XLEN-wide value in `rs1` and writes
+the result to `rd`. Bit 0 of the source becomes bit XLEN-1 of the result,
+bit 1 becomes bit XLEN-2, and so on.
